cells.gaps: The 45% is a rate of integration of public primary schools at 2 February 2026, with no numerator or denominator, and not a share entering marks; private primary schools are not split out. ANADEN's June 2025 entry calls e-Msomo a pilot, which the later registration by island supersedes; no source says the plan names e-Msomo, and the only finance stated is UNICEF's. The rural statement in COM-001 is from the excluded source and sets nothing.
cells.note: e-Msomo is past its launch pilot, with schools on all three islands registered and entering pupil lists and marks for report cards. Stage 4 needs more than half of primary schools entering results, and the one figure is 45% integrated.
